item.tib: lam mngon sangs rgyas pa'i rgyud
lam mngon sangs rgyas pa'i rgyud
item.note: text was revealed by gu-ru rnon-rtse (b. 1136) at dung-phor of rta-nag (see karmay, treasury, pp. 166-167). the colophon of the tbmc edition (1971) reads as follows: 'di'i brgyud pa ni / ston pa kun tu bzang po gsang mchog rgyal po / yum bzang za ring btsun / rgyal gshen mi lus bsam legs / phug pa'i snang ba mdog can / bar pa'i a nu 'phrag thag / sgo pa'i sad ne ga'u / mkha' 'gro ma lam gyi bya ra rnams / sprul sku 'gu ru rnon rtse / dmyal ston gzhon nu / sgom pa g.yung drung / sgom pa rin chen dpal / ye shes rgyal mtshan / 'jad pa zhang ston bsod nams dpal / chen po bsod rgyal / dpe gsum la dag par bstun nas / dge'o / gshen rgyal ba lhun grub phyag dpe la [g]tugs.
